title: Gentlewoman
summary: GEN'TLEWOMAN, noun [gentle and woman.] A woman of good family or of good breeding; a woman above the vulgar. 1. A woman who waits about the person of one of high rank. 2. A term of civility to a femal

inlines.v: GEN'TLEWOMAN, noun [gentle and woman.] A woman of good family or of good breeding; a woman above the vulgar. 1. A woman who waits about the person of one of high rank. 2. A term of civility to a female, sometimes ironical.
